chunks: Have you not seen that they wander distract in every valley,

key_terms.يَهِيمُونَ: they wander distractly or roam aimlessly

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'wandering in every valley'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a critique of the pre-Islamic Arabs' religious syncretism and lack of doctrinal coherence, serving as a precursor to the concept of *Fitrah* (innate disposition) which was obscured by such confusion. The imagery of wandering in every valley underscores the spiritual instability that results from deviating from the singular truth of Tawhid, a theme central to Imam Ali's teachings on the dangers of blind following (*Taqlid*).
